question: What will the first reported earnings per share after September 2026 be for the following companies? (SpaceX)

calls.reasoning: SpaceX's first report after September 2026 is Q3 2026, expected about Nov 3-17. Aggregators put consensus at $0.13-0.14 (12 analysts, range -0.11 to +0.29). Against that, the Cursor deal (closed Aug 14, about 391M new shares) brings deal costs, stock-based pay and amortization, and xAI costs keep rising. I set the median a little below consensus to allow for GAAP one-off risk at a newly listed company.
